cube.note: The cube model was already public in this repository: the released calibration_gan12.json is documented as the gtD1s demo cube's six-color calibration.

frame_index.origin_note: clip_frame = source_frame - 3919; frame 0 is the clip's first frame
frame_index.motion_frame_note: moves[].frame is the reconstruction onset series, which covers all 91 moves. moves[].motion_frame is an independent motion-snapped index that exists for the first 88 moves only and disagrees with frame on 6 of them (largest disagreement 10 frames). Neither series is a hand-labelled frame; both are estimates.

solve.scramble: R' L2 F L2 U R D F' U2 L B2 D2 F2 L2 B2 R2 U F2 B2 L2 D
solve.start_state_source: solve_only_variant of gtD1 @move-b (scramble-prefix stripped for product-faithful eval)

time_to_frame.fitted_on: the 91 verified move onsets in this artifact
time_to_frame.note: Least-squares fit only. Per-move onsets are locally refined, so this global line does not reproduce them exactly. Use moves[].frame for move timing; the fit exists to place orientation samples, which have no independently refined frame index.

canonical_moves_note: Derived here by collapsing adjacent same-face quarter turns. The BLE teacher logs quarter turns; the decoder emits half-turn metric. This field is a deterministic function of moves[].move and adds no new measurement.

states_encoding.layout: six row-major faces in U, R, F, D, L, B order
states_encoding.alphabet: URFDLB face letters, 54 characters per state
states_encoding.semantics: states[0] is the state before moves[0]; states[i + 1] is the state after moves[i]. The series is derived by replaying the recorded moves, not copied from the raw BLE snapshots.
states_encoding.ble_reported_state_index_note: The cube's raw facelet snapshot attached to each move event lags the move stream by 0 to 3 moves, with one sample that runs ahead. Rather than publish a misleading per-move state, each move carries the index into states that its raw snapshot actually equalled. That is lossless: states[ble_reported_state_index] reconstructs the raw snapshot exactly.

orientations_note: Cube-frame quaternions from the smart cube, rounded to 6 decimals. frame_approx comes from time_to_frame and is null for samples outside the clip window. Component order is as recorded by the cube and is not asserted to match any particular convention.

verification.note: These internal consistency checks establish that the preserved record is self-consistent. They are not an accuracy measurement of any decoder.

provenance.sources_note: The retained filenames identify the source records used to produce this reviewed, clip-local artifact. Raw source records are not part of the runtime Demo.

removed_fields.reason: absolute wall-clock start of a person's activity
opaque handle into the private ingest store
private ingest bookkeeping with no research value
lagging raw BLE snapshot; carried losslessly as ble_reported_state_index

scrub.retained_note: Cube model, relative t_ms, move tokens, clip-local frames, quality tiers, facelet states, orientations, and the scramble are retained on purpose. A quaternion identifies nobody and the cube model was already published with this repository's demo calibration.

evidence_boundary: Teacher ground truth for one solve by one person, on one cube, in one room. Publishing it makes a direct per-move comparison against a decoder possible for the first time. Any such comparison is a diagnostic on this single capture; it is not reach-LL, not a benchmark, and not evidence of generalization. See docs/EVIDENCE.md.
